entries.englishValue: Bitcoin doesn't have inflation
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinning inflyatsiyasi yoʻq

entries.englishValue: Inflation means your money buys you less over time. Bitcoin is better money because it doesn't have inflation.
entries.targetTranslation: Inflyatsiya — vaqt oʻtgani sayin pulingiz sizga kamroq narsa olib bera boshlashi degani. Bitcoin yaxshiroq pul, chunki uning inflyatsiyasi yoʻq.

entries.englishValue: because it has a maximum supply of 21 million Bitcoin. No one can print more Bitcoin.
entries.targetTranslation: chunki uning maksimal taklifi 21 million Bitcoin bilan cheklangan. Hech kim koʻproq Bitcoin bosib chiqara olmaydi.

entries.englishValue: Dollars have an unlimited supply, which means more can be printed at any time.
entries.targetTranslation: Dollarlar cheklanmagan taklifga ega, ya’ni istalgan paytda koʻproqini bosib chiqarish mumkin.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is scarce
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin tanqis

entries.englishValue: Historically, Bitcoin has gained purchasing power over time while the dollar has lost it. Many people use Bitcoin as their long-term savings account: money that they can leave alone and let grow for several years.
entries.targetTranslation: Tarixan, Bitcoin vaqt oʻtishi bilan xarid qobiliyatini oshirgan, dollar esa uni yoʻqotgan. Koʻp odamlar Bitcoindan oʻzlarining uzoq muddatli jamgʻarma hisobi sifatida foydalanadi: bu pulni tegmasdan, bir necha yil davomida oʻsishiga qoldirish mumkin.

entries.englishValue: Would you rather save in dollars that buy you less over time? Or save in Bitcoin that has historically bought you more over time?
entries.targetTranslation: Vaqt oʻtgani sayin sizga kamroq narsa olib beradigan dollarda jamgʻarishni xohlaysizmi? Yoki tarixan koʻproq narsa olib bergan Bitcoinda jamgʻarishnimi?

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is also a tool for freedom
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin shuningdek erkinlik vositasi

entries.englishValue: The Bitcoin network isn't owned by anyone. It isn't controlled by any government or corporation. It's designed to uphold your freedom and protect your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin tarmogʻi hech kimga tegishli emas. Uni hech qanday hukumat yoki korporatsiya boshqarmaydi. U sizning erkinligingizni qoʻllab-quvvatlash va pulingizni himoya qilish uchun yaratilgan.

entries.englishValue: People around the world are already using Bitcoin to protect their freedom — even when their own governments refused to help or tried to stop them.
entries.targetTranslation: Butun dunyo boʻylab odamlar oʻz erkinligini himoya qilish uchun Bitcoindan foydalanmoqda — hatto oʻz hukumatlari yordam berishdan bosh tortgan yoki ularni toʻxtatishga uringan paytlarda ham.

entries.englishValue: If you save in Australian Dollars, you've probably noticed that they buy you less each year. It takes more dollars to buy the same amount of food. You need more dollars to maintain your quality of life.
entries.targetTranslation: Agar siz Avstraliya dollarida jamgʻarsangiz, ehtimol ularning har yili sizga kamroq narsa olib berishini sezgansiz. Avvalgi miqdordagi oziq-ovqatni sotib olish uchun koʻproq dollar kerak boʻladi. Hayot sifatingizni saqlab qolish uchun esa koʻproq dollar kerak.

entries.englishValue: But it doesn't have to be this way.
entries.targetTranslation: Lekin bunday boʻlishi shart emas.

entries.englishValue: People who saved in Bitcoin over the last 4 years saw life get cheaper.
entries.targetTranslation: Soʻnggi 4 yil davomida Bitcoinda jamgʻargan odamlar uchun hayot arzonlashganini koʻrishgan.

entries.englishValue: Here's the proof: your money is losing value
entries.targetTranslation: Mana isboti: pulingiz qiymatini yoʻqotmoqda

entries.englishValue: The dollars in your bank account buy you less every year. That's because there is no fixed limit on how many dollars can be created.
entries.targetTranslation: Bank hisobingizdagi dollarlar har yili sizga kamroq narsa olib beradi. Buning sababi — qancha dollar yaratilishi mumkinligiga aniq cheklov yoʻqligida.

entries.englishValue: This unlimited supply is the root cause of inflation. Over recent years, the total amount of dollars in existence has increased dramatically.
entries.targetTranslation: Bu cheklanmagan taklif inflyatsiyaning asosiy sababidir. Soʻnggi yillarda mavjud dollarlarning umumiy miqdori keskin oshib bordi.

entries.englishValue: When more money is created from nothing, the price of everything goes up. This includes the raw materials that companies buy to make their products — which means higher prices for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Pul yoʻqdan bor qilinganda, hamma narsa narxi koʻtariladi. Bunga kompaniyalar oʻz mahsulotlarini ishlab chiqarish uchun sotib oladigan xomashyo ham kiradi — bu siz uchun yuqori narxlar degani.

entries.englishValue: And when the government continues to increase their debt, even more money is printed because less people want to lend them money.
entries.targetTranslation: Hukumat oʻz qarzini oshirishda davom etganida, yana koʻproq pul bosiladi, chunki kamroq odam unga qarz bermoqchi boʻladi.

entries.englishValue: , they just print the money.
entries.targetTranslation: , u shunchaki pul bosib chiqaradi.

entries.targetTranslation: Agar siz qarz ololmasangiz, pul sarflay olmaysiz. Lekin agar hukumat

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's protocol has stayed fundamentally the same since 2009, providing predictable rules. Most crypto projects constantly change protocols, tokenomics, or fork into new versions.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin protokoli 2009-yildan beri mohiyatan oʻzgarmagan holda qoldi va oson oʻzgartirib boʻlmaydigan bashorat qilinadigan qoidalarni taʼminlaydi. Koʻpchilik kripto loyihalari protokollarini tez-tez yangilaydi, token iqtisodiyotini oʻzgartiradi yoki yangi versiyalarga vilka qiladi, bu foydalanuvchilar uchun noaniqlik yaratadi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin protokoli 2009-yildan beri tubdan oʻzgarmasdan qoldi va bashorat qilinadigan qoidalarni taʼminlaydi. Koʻpchilik kripto loyihalari protokollarini, token iqtisodiyotini doimiy oʻzgartiradi yoki yangi versiyalarga vilka qiladi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a truly decentralized network with tens of thousands of independent nodes worldwide. Many crypto projects are controlled by foundations, companies, or small groups of developers who can make unilateral decisions about the protocol's future.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin runs on tens of thousands of independent nodes worldwide. Most crypto projects are controlled by foundations, companies, or small dev teams that can make unilateral changes.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin butun dunyoda oʻn minglab mustaqil tugunlarga ega haqiqiy markazsizlashtirilgan tarmoqda ishlaydi. Koʻplab kripto loyihalari protokolning kelajagi haqida bir tomonlama qarorlar qabul qila oladigan fondlar, kompaniyalar yoki kichik dasturchi guruhlari tomonidan nazorat qilinadi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin butun dunyoda oʻn minglab mustaqil tugunlarga ega. Koʻpchilik kripto loyihalari bir tomonlama oʻzgartirishlar kirita oladigan jamgʻarmalar, kompaniyalar yoki kichik dasturchi jamoalari tomonidan boshqariladi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million coins that will ever exist, making it the scarcest digital asset. Most crypto projects have unlimited supplies, inflationary mechanisms, or can mint new tokens at will, diluting holder value over time.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million coins — the scarcest digital asset. Most crypto projects have unlimited supplies or mechanisms to mint new tokens at will, diluting holders.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoinning hamma vaqt mavjud boʻladigan maksimal 21 million tangalik qatʼiy chegarasi bor va uni eng nodir raqamli aktivga aylantiradi. Koʻpchilik kripto loyihalarining chegarasiz taklifi, inflyatsion mexanizmlari yoki xohlagan vaqtda yangi token bosish imkoniyati bor va egalari qiymatini vaqt oʻtishi bilan suyultirib boradi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinning qatʼiy 21 million tangalik chegarasi bor — eng tanqis raqamli aktiv. Koʻpchilik kripto loyihalarida cheklanmagan taklif yoki egalari ulushini suyultirib boruvchi yangi tokenlar chiqarish mexanizmlari bor.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has one simple purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it with basic knowledge. Many crypto projects involve complex smart contracts, DeFi protocols, or governance mechanisms that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has one purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it. Most crypto involves complex smart contracts or DeFi that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoinning yagona oddiy maqsadi bor: tengdosh-dan-tengdoshga raqamli pul. Har kim asosiy bilim bilan tushunishi va foydalanishi mumkin. Koʻplab kripto loyihalari xavfsiz foydalanish uchun texnik tajriba talab qiladigan murakkab smart-shartnomalar, DeFi protokollari yoki boshqarish mexanizmlarini oʻz ichiga oladi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinning bitta maqsadi bor: tengdosh-dan-tengdoshga raqamli pul. Buni har kim tushunishi va ishlatishi mumkin. Koʻpchilik kripto murakkab smart-shartnoma yoki DeFi loyihalarini oʻz ichiga oladi va xavfsiz foydalanish uchun texnik tajriba talab qiladi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin uses Proof of Work consensus, which has been battle-tested for over 15 years without a single successful attack on the main network. Many crypto projects use experimental consensus mechanisms like Proof of Stake or delegated systems that haven't proven their long-term security.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's Proof of Work has run without a successful attack on the main network for over 15 years. Most crypto projects use experimental consensus that hasn't been battle-tested.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin asosiy tarmoqqa bitta ham muvaffaqiyatli hujumsiz 15 yildan ortiq vaqt davomida jangovar sharoitlarda sinab koʻrilgan Proof of Work konsensusidan foydalanadi. Koʻplab kripto loyihalari uzoq muddatli xavfsizligini hali isbotlamagan Proof of Stake yoki delegatsiyalangan tizimlar kabi eksperimental konsensus mexanizmlaridan foydalanadi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinning Proof of Work mexanizmi 15 yildan ortiq vaqt davomida asosiy tarmoqqa muvaffaqiyatli hujumsiz ishlab kelmoqda. Koʻpchilik kripto loyihalari hali sinalmagan eksperimental konsensusdan foydalanadi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin serves as digital money - a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are utility tokens for specific platforms, governance tokens, or speculative assets with unclear real-world value propositions.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is digital money — a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are speculative utility or governance tokens with unclear real-world value.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin raqamli pul sifatida xizmat qiladi — qiymat saqlash va almashuv vositasi. Koʻpchilik kripto tokenlari aniq platformalar uchun yordamchi tokenlar, boshqarish tokenlari yoki noaniq qiymat takliflari boʻlgan spekulyativ aktivlardir.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin — raqamli pul, qiymat saqlovchi va ayirboshlash vositasi. Koʻpchilik kripto tokenlari real qiymati noaniq spekulyativ yordamchi yoki boshqaruv tokenlaridir.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin becomes stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism thrown at it. Most crypto projects are fragile and can collapse from regulatory pressure, technical failures, or market downturns.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin grows stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism. Most crypto projects collapse under regulatory, technical, or market pressure.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin hujum ostida kuchayib boradi va unga yoʻnaltirilgan har bir inqiroz, taqiq va tanqiddan omon qoldi. Koʻpchilik kripto loyihalari zaif boʻlib, tartibga solish bosimi, texnik xatolar yoki bozor qulashlari ostida qulab tushishi mumkin.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin hujum ostida kuchayadi va har bir inqiroz, taqiq va tanqiddan omon qoldi. Koʻpchilik kripto loyihalari tartibga solish, texnik yoki bozor bosimi ostida qulab tushadi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company behind it, and no single point of failure. Many crypto projects are backed by venture capital firms, have identifiable leadership teams, or depend on specific companies for their continued operation.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company, no single point of failure. Most crypto projects depend on VCs, specific leadership, or one company's survival.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoinning bosh direktori yoʻq, ortida kompaniya yoʻq va bitta muvaffaqiyatsizlik nuqtasi yoʻq. Koʻplab kripto loyihalari venchur kapital firmalari tomonidan qoʻllab-quvvatlanadi, taniqli rahbariyatga ega yoki davom etayotgan operatsiyalar uchun aniq kompaniyalarga bogʻliq.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinning bosh direktori, kompaniyasi va yagona muvaffaqiyatsizlik nuqtasi yoʻq. Koʻpchilik kripto loyihalari venchur kapitalga, aniq rahbariyatga yoki bitta kompaniya omon qolishiga bogʻliq.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is perfectly fungible, meaning every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable - one bitcoin equals one bitcoin anywhere in the world. Fine art is non-fungible by nature, with each piece being unique in its creation, history, condition, and provenance, making direct comparisons and valuations extremely difficult.
entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every artwork is unique — different creation, history, condition, and provenance make direct comparisons extremely difficult.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin toʻliq almashtiriladigan, yaʼni har bir bitcoin teng va bir-biri bilan almashtirilishi mumkin — dunyoning qayerida boʻlsangiz ham bitta bitcoin bitta bitcoinga teng. Nozik sanʻat tabiatan almashtirib boʻlmaydigan; har bir asar yaratilishi, tarixi, holati va kelib chiqishi bilan noyobdir.
entries.targetTranslation: Har bir bitcoin teng va almashtirilishi mumkin. Har bir sanʼat asari noyob — turli yaratilish, tarix, holat va kelib chiqishi toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri solishtirishni nihoyatda qiyinlashtiradi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin trades on a global 24/7 market where anyone with internet access can buy or sell instantly. Fine art requires specialized auction houses like Sotheby's or Christie's, private dealers, or exclusive galleries. Sales can take months to arrange and complete, with limited market access and irregular trading opportunities.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades 24/7 on a global market accessible to anyone. Fine art requires specialized auction houses, private dealers, or galleries and can take months to sell.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin internet kirish huquqiga ega har kimning bir zumda oldi-sotdi qilishi mumkin boʻlgan 24/7 global bozorda savdo qilinadi. Nozik sanʻat Sothebyʻs yoki Christieʻs kabi mutaxassis kimoshdi uylari, xususiy dilerlar yoki xususiy galereyalarni talab qiladi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin har kimga ochiq global bozorda 24/7 savdo qilinadi. Nozik sanʻat ixtisoslashgan kimoshdi uylari, xususiy dilerlar yoki galereyalarni talab qiladi va sotish oylar davom etishi mumkin.

entries.englishValueBefore: Buying or selling bitcoin typically costs less than 1% in fees, often much less. Fine art sales involve substantial costs including buyer's premiums (10-25%), seller's commissions (10-15%), insurance, transportation, storage, and authentication fees. These combined costs can easily exceed 30-40% of the artwork's value in a single transaction.
entries.englishValue: Buying or selling Bitcoin costs under 1% in fees, often much less. Art sales rack up 30–40% in buyer's premiums, commissions, insurance, transport, and authentication fees.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin oldi-sotdisi odatda komissiyalarda 1%dan kam boʻlsa, koʻpincha ancha kam boʻladi. Sanʻat sotish xaridor mukofoti (10-25%), sotuvchi komissiyasi (10-15%), sugʻurta, tashish, saqlash va tasdiqlash toʻlovlari kabi sezilarli xarajatlarni oʻz ichiga oladi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinni sotib olish yoki sotish komissiyalarda 1%dan kam, koʻpincha undan ham kam turadi. Sanʻat sotuvi xaridor mukofoti, komissiya, sugʻurta, tashish va tasdiqlash toʻlovlarida 30–40% gacha boʻladi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size from microtransactions to large purchases. Fine art cannot be divided - you cannot own a fraction of a painting or sell just part of a sculpture. This indivisibility limits investment flexibility and liquidity options.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size transaction. You can't own a fraction of a painting or a corner of a sculpture without counterparty risk.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin satoshi deb ataladigan 100 million kichik birlikka boʻlinishi mumkin, bu uni har qanday hajmdagi tranzaksiya uchun ideal qiladi. Nozik sanʻat boʻlinmaydi — rasmning bir qismiga egalik qilish yoki haykalning faqat bir boʻlagini sotish mumkin emas.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin 100 million satoshiga boʻlinadi va har qanday hajmdagi tranzaksiyani amalga oshirish uchun mukammal. Rasmning bir qismiga yoki haykalning burchagiga kontragent xavfsiz egalik qilib boʻlmaydi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified on the blockchain by anyone with basic technical knowledge. Fine art requires expensive expert authentication, provenance research, and scientific analysis. Even with expert verification, forgeries regularly fool the art world, and authentication disputes can destroy an artwork's value overnight. Bitcoin, on the other hand, cannot be forged or counterfeited.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified by anyone on-chain. Art authentication is expensive, slow, and still routinely fooled by forgers — destroying an artwork's value overnight.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin mulkchiligi va haqiqiyligi asosiy texnik bilimga ega har kim tomonidan blokcheynda kriptografik tasdiqlanishi mumkin. Nozik sanʻat qimmat mutaxassis tasdiqlashi, kelib chiqish tadqiqoti va ilmiy tahlil talab qiladi. Mutaxassis tasdiqlashiga qaramay, soxta nusxalar muntazam ravishda sanʻat olamini aldab kelmoqda. Bitcoin esa soxta qilib boʻlmaydi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin mulkchiligi va haqiqiyligini har kim blokcheynda kriptografik tasdiqlay oladi. Sanʻat tasdiqlash qimmat va sekin, soxta nusxalar oʻz ishini qilib turadi — bu sanʻat asarining qiymatini bir kechada yoʻq qilishi mumkin.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, theft, or other disasters. Fine art is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and deterioration. Even with expensive climate-controlled storage and comprehensive insurance, artworks can be damaged by environmental factors, accidents, or natural disasters, potentially losing all value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives floods, fires, earthquakes, and theft. Fine art is vulnerable to every form of physical destruction, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin toʻgʻri zaxiralanganida suv toshqini, yongʻin, zilzila, dovul, oʻgʻirlik yoki boshqa ofatlar bilan yoʻq qilib boʻlmaydi. Nozik sanʻat jismoniy yoʻq qilish va buzilishning har bir shakliga himoyasiz.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin toʻgʻri zaxiralanganida suv toshqini, yongʻin, zilzila va oʻgʻirlikdan omon qoladi. Nozik sanʻat har qanday jismoniy yoʻq qilish shakllariga himoyasiz va sugʻurta hammasini qoplamaydi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold by anyone with internet access and a small amount of money to invest. Fine art investment is largely limited to wealthy collectors due to high minimum prices, exclusive auction access, storage requirements, insurance costs, and the specialized knowledge needed to navigate the art market successfully.
entries.englishValue: Anyone with an internet connection and a little money can buy Bitcoin. Fine art investment is effectively limited to wealthy collectors with auction access and specialized knowledge.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin internet kirish huquqi va investitsiya qilish uchun oz miqdordagi puli bor har kim tomonidan oldi-sotdi qilinishi mumkin. Nozik sanʻat investitsiyalari yuqori minimal narxlar, xususiy kimoshdi kirish huquqi, saqlash talablari, sugʻurta xarajatlari va mutaxassis bilimi tufayli katta darajada badavlat kolleksionerlar bilan cheklangan.
entries.targetTranslation: Internet aloqasi va oz miqdordagi puli bor har kim Bitcoin sotib olishi mumkin. Nozik sanʻat investitsiyasi amalda kimoshdi savdosiga kira oladigan va mutaxassis bilimi boʻlgan badavlat kolleksionerlar bilan cheklangan.

entries.englishValueBefore: Because Bitcoin is digital, it can be sent almost instantly for very low fees by anyone with an Internet connection. Because Gold is physical, it cannot be moved across the Internet and must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can be sent instantly over the internet for low fees. Gold must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin raqamli boʻlganligi sababli, internet aloqasi bor har kim uni deyarli bir zumda juda past komissiyalar bilan yuborishi mumkin. Oltin jismoniy boʻlganligi sababli, internet orqali oʻtkazib boʻlmaydi va mulkchilikni oʻtkazish uchun jismoniy yuborilishi kerak.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinni internet orqali bir zumda past komissiyalar bilan yuborish mumkin. Oltin esa mulkchilikni oʻzgartirish uchun jismoniy joʻnatilishi kerak.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset, which means you can transfer full ownership of it over the Internet. Some companies offer the ability to buy gold online without receiving the actual physical gold, instead trusting the company to hold the gold for you. This is more like a Digital IOU since you only own a promise from the company instead of the actual asset.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset you can transfer over the internet. Online gold is a Digital IOU — you only own a promise from a custodian, not the metal itself.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin raqamli mahalliy aktiv boʻlib, toʻliq mulkchilikni internet orqali oʻtkazishingiz mumkin. Baʼzi kompaniyalar jismoniy oltinni olmadan onlayn oltin sotib olish imkonini taklif qiladi; buning oʻrniga kompaniyaning oltinni siz uchun saqlashiga ishonasiz. Bu haqiqiy aktiv emas, balki faqat kompaniya vaʼdasiga ega boʻlganingiz sababli raqamli qarz hujjatiga koʻproq oʻxshaydi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin — internet orqali oʻzgartirish mumkin boʻlgan raqamli aktiv. Onlayn oltin esa raqamli qarz hujjati — siz aslida metallning oʻziga emas, qaramogʻidagi kompaniyaning vaʼdasiga egasiz.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 Million BTC that will ever exist.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million BTC. Gold's supply grows about 1.6% per year, shrinking your slice — less than fiat
entries.currentValue: Bitcoinning hamma vaqt mavjud boʻladigan maksimal 21 million BTC qatʼiy chegarasi bor.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinning qatʼiy 21 million BTC chegarasi bor. Oltin taklifi yiliga taxminan 1,6% oshib boradi va sizning ulushingizni kichraytiradi — fiat

entries.englishValueBefore: New gold supply is pulled out of the ground each year, resulting in inflation of the total supply. It's estimated that the total supply of gold increases by about 1.6% per year, which means your slice of the pie shrinks by 1.6% per year.
entries.englishValue: inflation
entries.currentValue: Har yili yangi oltin taklifi yerdan qazib olinadi va umumiy taklifga inflyatsiya keltiradi. Umumiy oltin taklifining yiliga taxminan 1,6% ga oshishi taxmin qilinadi, yaʼni pirogdagi ulushingiz har yili 1,6% ga kamayadi.
entries.targetTranslation: inflyatsiyasidan

entries.englishValueBefore: This is less than fiat inflation, but still inflation.
entries.englishValue: — but still inflation.
entries.currentValue: Bu fiat pul inflyatsiyasidan kam boʻlsada, baribir inflyatsiyadir.
entries.targetTranslation: kam, lekin baribir inflyatsiya.

entries.englishValueBefore: Gold has an elastic supply, meaning that as the price of gold rises, there is a greater incentive to mine more gold. This often puts downward pressure on the gold price as new mines come online.
entries.englishValue: When gold prices rise, more gold gets mined, pushing the price back down. Bitcoin's supply is inelastic — no matter how high the price goes, there will only ever be 21 million.
entries.currentValue: Oltinning elastik taklifi bor, yaʼni oltin narxi koʻtarilgan sayin, koʻproq oltin qazib olish uchun kattaroq motivatsiya paydo boʻladi. Bu yangi konlar ochilganda odatda oltin narxiga pastga bosim oʻtkazadi.
entries.targetTranslation: Oltin narxi koʻtarilganda koʻproq oltin qazib olinadi va bu narxni tushiradi. Bitcoinning taklifi noelastik — narx qanchalik koʻtarilsa ham, hech qachon 21 milliondan oshmaydi.

entries.englishValueBefore: The Bitcoin network is decentralized.
entries.englishValue: Tens of thousands of independent nodes validate the Bitcoin network. Most physical gold sits in a handful of large custodian vaults.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin tarmogʻi markazsizlashtirilgan.
entries.targetTranslation: Oʻn minglab mustaqil tugun Bitcoin tarmogʻini tasdiqlaydi. Koʻp jismoniy oltin esa bir nechta yirik qaramogʻidagi omborlarda yotadi.

entries.englishValueBefore: With Bitcoin, it's incredibly easy to verify that you have real Bitcoin by taking self-custody of your coins and running a full node.
entries.englishValue: Anyone can verify real Bitcoin by running a full node — it's just an app. Verifying physical gold requires melting it down; the inside could be tungsten.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin bilan coinlaringizni oʻz nazoratiga olib va toʻliq tugun ishlatib, haqiqiy Bitcoinga ega ekanligingizni tasdiqlash nihoyatda oson.
entries.targetTranslation: Har kim toʻliq tugun ishga tushirib haqiqiy Bitcoinni tasdiqlay oladi — bu shunchaki ilova. Jismoniy oltinni tasdiqlash uchun uni eritib koʻrish kerak; ichida volfram boʻlishi mumkin.

entries.englishValueBefore: Just like there are 100 cents in 1 dollar, there are 100,000,000 sats in 1 Bitcoin. This enables Bitcoin to be used for all scales of purchases, including microtransactions as small as a few cents.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size purchase. Gold can't be easily divided for small transactions.
entries.currentValue: 1 dollarda 100 sent boʻlgani kabi, 1 Bitcoinda 100,000,000 satoshi bor. Bu Bitcoinni bir necha sent qiymatidagi mikro tranzaksiyalar ham kiradi, har qanday hajmdagi savdolar uchun ishlatish imkonini beradi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin 100 million satoshiga boʻlinadi va har qanday xajmdagi xarid uchun mukammal. Oltinni esa kichik tranzaksiyalar uchun osongina boʻlib boʻlmaydi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be moved anywhere in the world instantly over the internet. Real estate is permanently fixed to a specific location and cannot be relocated, making it vulnerable to local economic conditions, natural disasters, and political instability.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin moves anywhere in the world instantly. Real estate is fixed to one location and exposed to local economic, political, and natural risks.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin internet orqali bir zumda dunyoning istalgan joyiga koʻchirilishi mumkin. Koʻchmas mulk maʼlum joyga doimiy oʻrnatilgan va koʻchirib boʻlmaydi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin dunyoning istalgan joyiga bir zumda harakatlanadi. Koʻchmas mulk bitta joyga bogʻlangan va mahalliy iqtisodiy, siyosiy va tabiiy xavflarga ochiq.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size. Real estate cannot be easily divided - you can't sell just the kitchen of your house or buy half a bedroom.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats. Real estate can't be partly sold — you can't offload just the kitchen or buy half a bedroom.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin satoshi deb ataladigan 100 million kichik birlikka boʻlinishi mumkin. Koʻchmas mulk oson boʻlinmaydi — uyingizning faqat oshxonasini sotish yoki yotoqxonaning yarmini sotib olish mumkin emas.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin 100 million satoshiga boʻlinadi. Koʻchmas mulkni qisman sota olmaysiz — faqat oshxonani sotib yoki yotoqxonaning yarmini sotib olib boʻlmaydi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is subject to extensive government regulation including rent control, eviction moratoriums, zoning laws, and eminent domain where governments can seize your property.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is heavily regulated — zoning, rent control, eminent domain, and seizure all apply.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin hech qanday hukumat nazorat qila olmaydigan markazsizlashtirilgan tarmoqda ishlaydi. Koʻchmas mulk ijara tartibga solish, koʻchirib yuborish moratoriyalari, zonalash qonunlari va majburiy sotib olishni oʻz ichiga olgan keng qamrovli davlat tartibga solishiga boʻysinadi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin hech bir hukumat nazorat qila olmaydigan markazsizlashtirilgan tarmoqda ishlaydi. Koʻchmas mulk qattiq tartibga solinadi — zonalash, ijara nazorati, majburiy musodara va musodara qilish.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin requires no maintenance - it exists as digital code on a network. Real estate requires constant upkeep including repairs, renovations, property management, insurance, and dealing with tenants if rented.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin requires no upkeep. Real estate demands repairs, renovations, insurance, property management, and tenant issues.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin taʼmirlash talab qilmaydi — tarmoqdagi raqamli kod sifatida mavjud. Koʻchmas mulk taʼmirlash, qayta qurish, mulk boshqarish, sugʻurta va ijarachilar bilan muomala qilishni oʻz ichiga olgan doimiy eʻtibor talab qiladi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin parvarish talab qilmaydi. Koʻchmas mulk taʼmirlash, qayta qurish, sugʻurta, mulk boshqarish va ijarachilar bilan bogʻliq muammolarni talab qiladi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes - you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate is subject to annual property taxes that must be paid regardless of whether the property generates income, effectively forcing you to rent your own property from the government forever.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes — you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate owes annual property taxes regardless of income.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoinning davom etadigan soligʻi yoʻq — faqat sotganingizda kapital daromad soligʻini toʻlaysiz. Koʻchmas mulk mulk daromad keltiradimi yoki yoʻqmi, qatʼiy nazar toʻlanishi kerak boʻlgan yillik mulk soligʻiga boʻysinadi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinning davom etadigan soligʻi yoʻq — faqat sotganda kapital daromadi soligʻini toʻlaysiz. Koʻchmas mulk daromaddan qatʼi nazar yillik mulk soligʻini talab qiladi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, or other natural disasters. Real estate is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and requires expensive insurance that may not fully cover losses.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives fire, flood, and earthquake. Real estate is vulnerable to every disaster, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin toʻgʻri zaxiralanganida suv toshqini, yongʻin, zilzila, dovul yoki boshqa tabiiy ofatlar bilan yoʻq qilib boʻlmaydi. Koʻchmas mulk jismoniy yoʻq qilishning har bir shakliga himoyasiz.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin toʻgʻri zaxiralanganida yongʻin, suv toshqini va zilziladan omon qoladi. Koʻchmas mulk har qanday ofatga himoyasiz va sugʻurta hammasini qoplamaydi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable - one bitcoin equals one bitcoin anywhere in the world. Every piece of real estate is unique with different locations, conditions, and characteristics, making it difficult to price and compare properties.
entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every property is unique, making pricing and comparisons difficult.
entries.currentValue: Har bir bitcoin teng va bir-biri bilan almashtirilishi mumkin — dunyoning qayerida boʻlsangiz ham bitta bitcoin bitta bitcoinga teng. Har bir koʻchmas mulk turli joylar, holatlar va xususiyatlar bilan noyobdir.
entries.targetTranslation: Har bir bitcoin teng va almashtirilishi mumkin. Har bir mulk noyob va bu narxlash hamda solishtirishni qiyinlashtiradi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold 24/7 by anyone with internet access anywhere in the world. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers, require lengthy processes with lawyers and agents, and can take months to complete.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades globally 24/7 by anyone with internet access. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers and can take months of paperwork to close.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin internet kirish huquqiga ega har kim tomonidan dunyoning istalgan joyidan 24/7 oldi-sotdi qilinishi mumkin. Koʻchmas mulk sotish mahalliy xaridorlar bilan cheklangan, advokatlar va agentlar bilan uzoq jarayonlarni talab qiladi va oylar davom etishi mumkin.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin internet kirish huquqiga ega har kim tomonidan global miqyosda 24/7 savdo qilinadi. Koʻchmas mulk sotuvi mahalliy xaridorlar bilan cheklangan va yopilishi uchun oylab hujjatlashtirish kerak.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership without intermediaries, promoting financial sovereignty for everyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence contributes to the financialization of housing, treating homes as commodities rather than shelter. This drives up prices, reduces affordability for families, and contributes to the housing and homelessness crisis affecting many countries today.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership for anyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence drives up housing prices, reducing affordability and fueling the housing crisis.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin vositachilarsiz bevosita individual mulkchilikni imkon qiladi va hamma uchun moliyaviy suverenitetni qoʻllab-quvvatlaydi. Asosiy uy-joyingizdan tashqari investitsiya sifatida koʻchmas mulk sotib olish uylarning boshpana oʻrniga tovar boʻladigan uy-joyning moliyaviylashtrilishiga hissa qoʻshadi. Bu narxlarni oshiradi, oilalar uchun arzonlikni kamaytiradi va uy-joy inqirozi va uysizlikka hissa qoʻshadi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin har kim uchun toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri individual mulkchilikni imkon qiladi. Asosiy turar joyingizdan tashqari investitsiya sifatida koʻchmas mulk sotib olish uy-joy narxlarini oshiradi, arzonligini kamaytiradi va uy-joy inqiroziga yondoshadi.

entries.englishValueBefore: When you own Bitcoin, you have direct ownership of the asset itself. When you own stocks, you own a share of a company, which means your investment depends on the company's performance, management decisions, and business success.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a direct asset you own outright. Stocks are shares in a company — their value depends on management, performance, and decisions you can't control.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoinga ega boʻlganingizda, aktivning oʻzida bevosita mulkchilikka egasiz. Aksiyaga ega boʻlganingizda, kompaniyadagi ulushga egasiz, yaʼni investitsiyangiz kompaniya faoliyati, boshqaruv qarorlari va biznes muvaffaqiyatiga bogʻliq.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin — siz toʻliq egalik qiladigan toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri aktiv. Aksiya esa kompaniyadagi ulush — uning qiymati siz nazorat qilolmaydigan rahbariyat, samaradorlik va qarorlarga bogʻliq.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network with no single point of failure. Stock investments are subject to key person risk - if the CEO or other critical leaders leave, get sick, or make poor decisions, your investment can suffer significantly. Companies depend heavily on their leadership teams.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO and no single point of failure. Stocks depend heavily on leadership — one bad decision or departure can tank the price.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin yagona muvaffaqiyatsizlik nuqtasi yoʻq markazsizlashtirilgan tarmoqda ishlaydi. Aksiya investitsiyalari kalit shaxs xavfiga boʻysinadi — bosh direktor yoki boshqa kalit rahbarlar ketsa, kasalansa yoki yomon qarorlar qilsa, investitsiyangiz sezilarli darajada zarar koʻrishi mumkin.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinning bosh direktori va yagona muvaffaqiyatsizlik nuqtasi yoʻq. Aksiya esa rahbariyatga juda bogʻliq — bitta yomon qaror yoki ketish narxni qulatishi mumkin.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin's price is determined purely by market supply and demand. Stock prices are often evaluated using P/E ratios (Price-to-Earnings), which show how much investors pay for each dollar of company earnings. High P/E ratios can indicate overvalued stocks, making it harder to determine fair value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's price comes from open global markets. Stock valuations rely on metrics like P/E ratios that can mask overpriced shares.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoinning narxi toʻliq bozor taklifi va talabi tomonidan belgilanadi. Aksiya narxlari odatda investorlar kompaniya daromadining har bir dollari uchun qancha toʻlayotganini koʻrsatadigan P/E (narx/daromad) nisbati bilan baholanadi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin narxi ochiq global bozorlardan keladi. Aksiya baholashi P/E nisbati kabi koʻrsatkichlarga tayanadi va bu haddan tashqari narxlanganligini yashirishi mumkin.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin trades 24 hours a day, 7 days a week on global exchanges.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades 24/7 around the world. Stock markets are only open during business hours on weekdays.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin global birzhalarda kuniga 24 soat, haftasiga 7 kun savdo qilinadi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin butun dunyoda 24/7 savdo qilinadi. Aksiya bozorlari faqat hafta kunlari ish soatlarida ochiq.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a fixed supply asset with a hard cap of 21 million Bitcoin that will ever exist. This makes it a great inflation hedge. Stocks have variable performance against inflation - some companies do well during inflationary periods while others struggle. There's no guarantee that any particular stock will protect against inflation.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's fixed supply makes it a reliable inflation hedge. Some stocks beat inflation, others don't — there's no guarantee.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin hamma vaqt mavjud boʻladigan maksimal 21 million Bitcoin chegarasiga ega qatʼiy taklifli aktiv. Bu uni mukammal inflyatsiya himoyasi qiladi. Aksiyalarning inflyatsiyaga nisbatan oʻzgaruvchan samaradorligi bor — baʼzi kompaniyalar inflyatsiya davrlarida muvaffaqiyatga erishadi, boshqalari qiyinchilik chekadi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinning qatʼiy taklifi uni ishonchli inflyatsiya himoyasiga aylantiradi. Baʼzi aksiyalar inflyatsiyani yengadi, baʼzilari yoʻq — kafolat yoʻq.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is an open network that anyone can join and use without permission. Credit card networks like Visa are closed systems controlled by financial institutions that can deny access to anyone they choose.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is an open network anyone can join and use without permission. Visa is a closed system controlled by financial institutions that can deny access — especially to the unbanked and underbanked.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin har kim ruxsatsiz qatnashishi va foydalanishi mumkin boʻlgan ochiq tarmoq. Visa kabi kredit karta tarmoqlari moliya muassasalarining herkimga kirishni rad etishi mumkin boʻlgan yopiq tizimlar.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can't be frozen by any central authority. Visa can freeze accounts, block transactions, or deny service at any time.

entries.englishValueBefore: Accepting Bitcoin has many benefits like accepting payments with lower fees & getting more customers.
entries.englishValue: The simplest way to accept Bitcoin is with a hybrid wallet that automatically sells 100% of the Bitcoin you receive for dollars (or your local currency) the instant a payment comes in.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin qabul qilishning pastroq komissiyalar bilan toʻlov olish va koʻproq mijoz jalb qilish kabi koʻplab afzalliklari bor.

entries.englishValueBefore: If you use a Hybrid Wallet from our Wallet Guide and automatically sell 100% of the Bitcoin you receive for dollars, you don't need to make any changes to your current accounting.
entries.englishValue: With this setup, your books look exactly like they do today — the final number is in dollars, every time. No cost basis, no capital gains, no new spreadsheets.
entries.currentValue: Hamyon yoʻriqnomamizdagi gibrid hamyonni ishlatayotgan va olgan Bitcoinning 100%ini avtomatik dollarga sotayotgan boʻlsangiz, mavjud buxgalteriyangizdagi hech narsani oʻzgartirishingiz shart emas.

entries.englishValueBefore: Tracking your cost basis is going to be the biggest difference between accounting for dollars and accounting for Bitcoin. Even if you view your business entirely in terms of Bitcoin, you need to report the dollar value of each transaction on your taxes.
entries.englishValue: Some businesses choose to keep a portion of the Bitcoin they receive instead of auto-converting it all. If that's you, the main extra step is tracking your cost basis — the dollar value of each Bitcoin payment on the day you received it.
entries.currentValue: Xarajat asosini kuzatish dollar buxgalteriyasi va Bitcoin buxgalteriyasi oʻrtasidagi eng katta farq boʻladi. Biznesingizga toʻliq Bitcoin nuqtai nazaridan qarasangiz ham, soliq deklaratsiyangizda har bir tranzaksiyaning dollar qiymatini hisobot qilishingiz kerak.
entries.targetTranslation: Baʼzi bizneslar olgan Bitcoinning hammasini avtomatik konvertatsiya qilish oʻrniga bir qismini saqlab qolishni tanlaydi. Agar bu siz boʻlsangiz, asosiy qoʻshimcha qadam — xarajat asosini kuzatish, yaʼni har bir Bitcoin toʻlovining olingan kunidagi dollar qiymatini yozib qoʻyish.

entries.englishValueBefore: If you use QuickBooks, you can do this automatically using the Bitcoin Sync plugin.
entries.englishValue: Even if you think of your business entirely in Bitcoin, most tax authorities still want the dollar value reported. The good news: it's just two numbers per transaction — the amount of Bitcoin received and its dollar value on that day.
entries.currentValue: QuickBooks ishlatayotgan boʻlsangiz, buni Bitcoin Sync plaginasi bilan avtomatik qilishingiz mumkin.
entries.targetTranslation: Biznesingizni butunlay Bitcoin nuqtai nazaridan koʻrayotgan boʻlsangiz ham, koʻpchilik soliq idoralari hali ham dollar qiymatining hisobotini talab qiladi. Yaxshi xabar: bu har bir tranzaksiya uchun atigi ikkita raqam — olingan Bitcoin miqdori va oʻsha kungi dollar qiymati.

entries.englishValueBefore: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. This makes your money worth less over time.
entries.englishValue: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. That makes the money in your pocket worth less over time — and it's why prices keep going up year after year.
entries.currentValue: Inflyatsiya yoʻqdan koʻproq pul bosilganda yoki yaratilganda yuzaga keladi. Bu pulingizning vaqt oʻtishi bilan qadrsizlanishiga olib keladi.
entries.targetTranslation: Inflyatsiya yoʻqdan koʻproq pul bosilganda yoki yaratilganda yuzaga keladi. Bu cho‘ntakingizdagi pulning vaqt oʻtgani sayin qadrsizlanishiga olib keladi — va shuning uchun narxlar yildan-yilga oshib boradi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a fixed supply, which means no one can print more Bitcoin.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a fixed supply of 21 million coins. No government, bank, or company can print more of it. Your Bitcoin savings hold their value over time instead of quietly losing it.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoinning qatʼiy taklifi bor, yaʼni hech kim koʻproq Bitcoin bosa olmaydi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinning 21 million tangadan iborat qatʼiy taklifi bor. Hech qanday hukumat, bank yoki kompaniya undan koʻproqini bosa olmaydi. Bitcoindagi jamgʻarmangiz vaqt oʻtishi bilan jimgina qadrini yoʻqotmasdan saqlab qoladi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Multiple US banks have collapsed in the past few years due to bank runs.
entries.englishValue: Multiple U.S. banks have collapsed in recent years because of bank runs. When too many customers tried to withdraw at once, the banks didn't have the cash to pay everyone back.
entries.currentValue: Soʻnggi yillarda bir qancha Amerika banklari bank hujumlari tufayli qulab tushdi.
entries.targetTranslation: Soʻnggi yillarda bir qator AQSh banklari bank hujumlari tufayli qulab tushdi. Juda koʻp mijozlar bir vaqtning oʻzida pul yechib olishga uringanida banklarda hammaga toʻlash uchun naqd pul yetishmadi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Instead of just holding your money for you, banks invest and lend out your money. If those investments don't do well, they don't have enough to pay you back.
entries.englishValue: Instead of just holding your money, banks lend and invest most of it. If those investments go bad — or if depositors lose confidence — the bank can fail, and your deposits can be frozen or lost.
entries.currentValue: Banklar pulingizni shunchaki saqlab turish oʻrniga, investitsiya qiladi va qarzga beradi. Agar bu investitsiyalar muvaffaqiyatsiz boʻlsa, pulingizni qaytarib berish uchun yetarli mablagʻlari qolmaydi.
entries.targetTranslation: Banklar pulingizni shunchaki saqlash oʻrniga uning katta qismini qarzga beradi va investitsiya qiladi. Agar bu investitsiyalar muvaffaqiyatsiz boʻlsa — yoki depozitorlar ishonchini yoʻqotsa — bank qulashi mumkin va depozitlaringiz muzlatilishi yoki yoʻqolishi mumkin.

entries.englishValueBefore: And the FDIC insurance fund only has $1 for every $100 they're insuring.
entries.englishValue: With Bitcoin, you can hold your own money directly in your own wallet. No bank. No intermediary. No bank run.
entries.currentValue: Va FDIC sugʻurta fondi oʻzi sugʻurtalagan har 100 dollarning atigi 1 dollariga ega.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin bilan pulingizni toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri oʻz hamyoningizda saqlay olasiz. Bank yoʻq. Vositachi yoʻq. Bank hujumi yoʻq.

entries.englishValueBefore: Unlike traditional financial networks, Bitcoin doesn't require permission to be used.
entries.englishValue: Unlike credit cards, PayPal, or traditional bank accounts, Bitcoin doesn't require anyone's permission to use.
entries.currentValue: Anʻanaviy moliya tarmoqlaridan farqli oʻlaroq, Bitcoin foydalanish uchun ruxsat talab qilmaydi.
entries.targetTranslation: Kredit kartalari, PayPal yoki anʼanaviy bank hisoblaridan farqli oʻlaroq, Bitcoin foydalanish uchun hech kimning ruxsatini talab qilmaydi.

entries.englishValueBefore: That means no one can stop you from using Bitcoin for any reason. It's the first financial network you can use without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.englishValue: No one can freeze your account, block a payment, or cut you off from the network. It's the first financial system in history you can use freely, without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.currentValue: Bu hech kim hech qanday sababga koʻra sizning Bitcoin ishlatishingizni toʻxtata olmasligini anglatadi. Bu siz senzura yoki musodara qilish xavfisiz foydalanishingiz mumkin boʻlgan birinchi moliyaviy tarmoqdir.
entries.targetTranslation: Hech kim hisobingizni muzlata olmaydi, toʻlovni toʻsa olmaydi yoki sizni tarmoqdan uza olmaydi. Bu — tarixda senzura yoki musodaradan qoʻrqmasdan erkin foydalanish mumkin boʻlgan birinchi moliyaviy tizim.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a misunderstood technology that is building a better world.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is often misunderstood, but it's quietly doing a lot of good in the world.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin yaxshiroq dunyo qurayotgan notoʻgʻri tushunilgan texnologiyadir.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin koʻpincha notoʻgʻri tushuniladi, lekin u dunyoda jimgina koʻp yaxshi ishlarni qilib bormoqda.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has enabled human rights activists to fight for freedom, reduced global methane emissions, saved national parks, and so much more.
entries.englishValue: It has helped human rights activists fight for freedom, reduced global methane emissions from landfills and oil fields, stabilized electric grids, and funded public goods like national parks.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inson huquqlari himoyachilariga ozodlik uchun kurashda yordam berdi, global metan chiqindilarini kamaytirdi, milliy bogʻlarni saqlab qoldi va yana koʻp narsalarni amalga oshirdi.
entries.targetTranslation: U inson huquqlari faollarining ozodlik uchun kurashishiga yordam berdi, axlatxonalar va neft konlaridan global metan chiqindilarini kamaytirdi, elektr tarmoqlarini barqarorlashtirdi va milliy bogʻlar kabi jamoat manfaatlarini moliyalashtirdi.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a full-reserve system. You're not depositing your money in a bank. You are your own bank. There's no lending out your money without your knowledge because you are the only one who can access your money.

entries.englishValue: As long as you hold bitcoin in your own wallet — not on an exchange or wrapped in an ETF — bank runs are impossible.

entries.englishValue: If too many people try to withdraw at the same time, the bank doesn't have enough cash to pay everyone. That's a bank run — and it can cause banks to collapse entirely.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin at your business doesn't have to complicate your accounting. Here's the short version — plus the tools and pros to make it painless.
entries.targetTranslation: Biznesingizda Bitcoinni qabul qilish buxgalteriyangizni murakkablashtirishi shart emas. Mana qisqa versiyasi — uni ogʻriqsiz qiladigan vositalar va mutaxassislar bilan birga.

entries.englishValue: If you already accept cash or card, adding Bitcoin to your business books is simpler than it looks. You have two paths: auto-convert every Bitcoin payment to dollars the moment it arrives (no new accounting needed), or keep some as Bitcoin (a few extra numbers to track).
entries.targetTranslation: Agar siz allaqachon naqd pul yoki karta qabul qilayotgan boʻlsangiz, biznes hisobotingizga Bitcoinni qoʻshish koʻrinishdan koʻra ancha sodda. Sizda ikki yoʻl bor: har bir Bitcoin toʻlovi kelgan zahoti uni avtomatik dollarga oʻtkazish (yangi buxgalteriya kerak emas) yoki bir qismini Bitcoin koʻrinishida saqlash (kuzatiladigan bir necha qoʻshimcha raqam).

entries.englishValue: This guide walks you through both — so you can pick the one that fits your business and start accepting Bitcoin with confidence.
entries.targetTranslation: Ushbu yoʻriqnoma sizni har ikkalasi orqali olib boradi — shunda biznesingizga mos keluvchisini tanlab, Bitcoinni ishonch bilan qabul qilishni boshlashingiz mumkin.

entries.englishValue: That's it. The underlying math is identical to how any other appreciating or depreciating asset is accounted for.
entries.targetTranslation: Tamom. Asosidagi matematika boshqa har qanday qiymati oshib yoki kamayib boruvchi aktivni hisobga olish bilan bir xil.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin wallets are free. Pick one that fits your business — in-person, online, or invoice-based — and start accepting Bitcoin in minutes.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for invoice-based businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Invoys asosidagi bizneslar uchun hamyonlar

entries.englishValue: If you invoice clients (consulting, freelancing, B2B services), use a wallet built around invoicing. Your client pays a Bitcoin invoice in a couple of clicks.
entries.targetTranslation: Agar mijozlarga invoys yuborsangiz (konsalting, frilans, B2B xizmatlar), invoys atrofida qurilgan hamyondan foydalaning. Mijozingiz bir necha bosish bilan Bitcoin invoysini toʻlaydi.

entries.englishValue: If you have a team taking payments at the register, choose a wallet that supports multiple employee logins — so every employee gets their own PIN and you keep a clean audit trail of who took which payment.

entries.englishValue: If you run a shop, café, studio, or service on your own, any of these wallets will work. Pick based on whether you want to keep payments in Bitcoin or auto-convert part of each payment to your local currency.

entries.englishValue: Strike Business lets you accept Bitcoin and Lightning payments with zero fees and instant settlement. Supports in-person, online, and invoice-based payments with optional auto-conversion to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Strike Business sizga Bitcoin va Lightning toʻlovlarini nol komissiya va bir zumda hisob-kitob bilan qabul qilish imkonini beradi. Yuzma-yuz, onlayn va invoys asosidagi toʻlovlarni qoʻllab-quvvatlaydi, ixtiyoriy mahalliy valyutaga avtomatik konvertatsiya qiladi.

entries.englishValue: Lower fees, more for the business
entries.targetTranslation: Pastroq komissiya, biznes uchun koʻproq foyda

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments skip the banks and credit card companies that take 2–3% from every sale. The business keeps more of what you pay — which often means better prices and better service for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin toʻlovlari har bir savdodan 2–3% oladigan banklar va kredit karta kompaniyalarini chetlab oʻtadi. Biznes siz toʻlagan summadan koʻproqini saqlab qoladi — bu odatda siz uchun yaxshiroq narx va yaxshiroq xizmat demakdir.

entries.englishValue: Instant settlement, no chargebacks
entries.targetTranslation: Bir zumda hisob-kitob, qaytarib olishlar yoʻq

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments settle in seconds, directly from your wallet to the business. There's no waiting days for a bank to release funds, and no costly chargeback disputes — so the business can focus on serving customers instead of fighting fraud.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin toʻlovlari bir necha soniyada hamyoningizdan toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri biznesga oʻtadi. Mablagʻ chiqarilishini bank kunlab kutib turish kerak emas va qimmat qaytarib olish nizolari yoʻq — biznes firibgarlikka qarshi kurash oʻrniga mijozlarga xizmat koʻrsatishga eʼtibor qaratishi mumkin.

entries.englishValue: Free to accept, open to everyone
entries.targetTranslation: Qabul qilish bepul, hammaga ochiq

entries.englishValue: There are no contracts, monthly fees, or setup costs for a business to accept Bitcoin. And millions of Bitcoin users around the world actively seek out merchants that accept it — giving this business free exposure to new customers.
entries.targetTranslation: Biznes uchun Bitcoinni qabul qilish boʻyicha shartnomalar, oylik toʻlovlar yoki sozlash xarajatlari yoʻq. Va dunyodagi millionlab Bitcoin foydalanuvchilari uni qabul qiladigan savdogarlarni faol qidirishadi — bu biznesga yangi mijozlarga bepul koʻrinish imkonini beradi.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin lets a business keep more of every sale, get paid instantly with no chargebacks, and reach a global audience of Bitcoin users — all with zero contracts and zero monthly fees.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinni qabul qilish biznesga har bir savdodan koʻproqini saqlab qolish, qaytarib olishlarsiz bir zumda toʻlov olish va Bitcoin foydalanuvchilarining global auditoriyasiga yetib borish imkonini beradi — barchasi nol shartnoma va nol oylik toʻlov bilan.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin isn't just useful at the cash register — it's a better form of money that protects your savings, your privacy, and your freedom to transact. Here's a quick overview.

entries.englishValue: bitcoin.rocks is a free, open-source project licensed under the MIT License. Our mission is to accelerate Bitcoin adoption through education — and we can't do it alone.

entries.englishValue: Nostr clients are free apps that let you read and post on the Nostr network. All of them are interoperable — you can switch clients anytime and keep your followers and content.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr klientlari — Nostr tarmogʻida oʻqish va yozish imkonini beradigan bepul ilovalar. Ularning hammasi bir-biri bilan ishlay oladi — istalgan vaqtda klientlarni almashtirib, obunachi va kontentingizni saqlab qola olasiz.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new decentralized protocol for communicating online — no single company controls it, Bitcoin zaps are built in, and you can move between apps without losing your followers.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr — onlayn muloqot uchun yangi markazsizlashtirilgan protokol — uni yagona kompaniya nazorat qilmaydi, Bitcoin zaplari oʻrnatilgan va obunachilaringizni yoʻqotmasdan ilovalar oʻrtasida koʻchib yura olasiz.

entries.englishValue: What is Nostr?
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr nima?

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email: no one owns the protocol, anyone can build an app on top of it, and you can pick whichever app you like best. Unlike Twitter or Facebook, there's no central company that can censor, deplatform, or deboost you.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr elektron pochtaga oʻxshaydi: hech kim protokolga ega emas, har kim uning ustida ilova qura oladi va sizga yoqqanini tanlashingiz mumkin. Twitter yoki Facebookdan farqli oʻlaroq, sizni senzura qila oladigan, blokdan oʻtkaza oladigan yoki koʻrinishini kamaytira oladigan markaziy kompaniya yoʻq.
